title: West Palm Beach
content: Here's a watercolor sketch painted on location a couple of nights ago in West Palm Beach, Florida.For those in south Florida, I'll be giving a digital slide presentation at 3:00 p.m. today at the Norton Museum of Art, followed by a booksigning. Hope to see you there. Bring the kids and bring your books to be signed. The signing is at 4:00 (there will be books and a poster available there, too).-----Art Daily report on the showFine Art NewsNorton Museum site
